note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic researchers ramp up calls for AI slowdown as warnings of catastrophic risk intensify
items.blurb: Researchers inside both frontier labs publicly urge slowing down; Anthropic's alignment lead cites over-10% catastrophic-risk odds.

items.title: Powering AI is an architecture problem
items.blurb: A July Ashburn fault dropped 3 GW in seconds, showing AI data-center clusters now stress grid architecture itself.

items.title: Healthcare AI's next test is integration
items.blurb: Argues healthcare AI's next decade turns on integrating models into governed data, workflows, and oversight — not raw capability.

items.title: DOJ investigates Nvidia's deal with Groq
items.blurb: Justice Department probes whether Nvidia's $20 billion Groq licensing deal was structured to skirt antitrust review of AI acquisitions.

items.title: Governments use Claude to spy on people, Anthropic warns
items.blurb: Anthropic threat report finds government-linked actors in Mali, China and Iran using Claude to streamline surveillance operations.

items.title: Wall Street firm believes the AI stock market boom is 'nearing an end'
items.blurb: Capital Economics says most indicators show the AI-driven equity rally is nearing its end, reiterating its bubble call.

items.title: Humans need to 'surf the wave' of AI rather than get swallowed by it, Chesky says at Communacopia
items.blurb: Airbnb's Chesky likens AI to nuclear power at Goldman's Communacopia conference, urging companies to ride the wave, not drown.

items.title: Elon Musk's X is the AI community group chat
items.blurb: X has become the AI industry's de-facto group chat, shaping release hype cycles and researcher discourse.

items.title: OpenAI claims to have solved the 90-year-old Navier-Stokes math problem in 88 hours
items.blurb: OpenAI says ~10,000 concurrent agents resolved the Millennium Prize problem in 88 hours; a mathematician is challenging the claim.

items.title: The Download: OpenAI's turning point for math and a battery record
items.blurb: MIT Tech Review weighs OpenAI's Navier-Stokes claim as a turning point for AI-assisted mathematics amid the credit dispute.

items.title: Apple event: Ternus announces iPhone 18 Pro as Siri AI nears public release
items.blurb: Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro at its first Ternus-led launch, with the new Siri AI expected to ship alongside.

items.title: Suno launches v6 AI music models with Warner Music Group, BMG
items.blurb: Suno's v6 family is trained on licensed Warner/BMG catalogs with revenue sharing, retiring unlicensed models — a template for legal music AI.

items.title: AI data centers won't create as many UK jobs as the tech sector projects, think tank warns
items.blurb: UK think tank says data-center employment claims are overstated, sharpening scrutiny of buildout-for-jobs arguments.

items.title: OpenAI adds AI safety official to its board
items.blurb: RLHF pioneer Paul Christiano joins OpenAI's board and its safety and security committee amid intensifying slowdown calls.

items.title: AI's extinction debate breaks containment
items.blurb: Anthropic alignment lead's above-10% catastrophic-risk estimate pushes the extinction-risk argument into mainstream business coverage.

items.title: Labs are begging for someone to slow the AI race
items.blurb: OpenAI and Nvidia leaders invoke AGI's arrival while alignment researchers publicly urge the race to slow down.

items.title: AI in Mathematics Is Forcing Big Questions
items.blurb: Mathematicians including Terence Tao weigh what theorem-proving AI means for the profession's role.

items.title: Axios C-Suite: The 4 ways that AI could play out
items.blurb: Scenario planning for CEOs, from superintelligence by 2027 to AI-catastrophe backlash movements.

items.title: Mistral bags $24 billion valuation as Samsung leads funding for Europe's AI champion
items.blurb: The $3.5B round is the largest European tech equity raise ever; funds go to Mistral's own data centers.

items.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML's newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
items.blurb: High-NA EUV adoption locked in — Samsung for DRAM by 2028, TSMC by 2030 — as AI chip demand compounds.

items.title: OpenAI claims huge maths breakthrough on a famed 'Millennium Problem'
items.blurb: OpenAI says an internal model proved Navier-Stokes can break down; Clay Institute calls it exciting, verification pending.

items.title: OpenAI's historic math solution overshadowed by credit controversy
items.blurb: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster alleges pressure over authorship and asks whether his Codex drafts fed OpenAI's claimed Navier-Stokes proof.

items.title: Qualcomm issues warrants to Amazon to acquire $4 billion worth of chipmaker's stock as part of AI infrastructure deal
items.blurb: AWS may buy up to $60B of Qualcomm inference chips — Qualcomm's first Western hyperscaler win, challenging Nvidia.

items.title: Meta's personal AI agents face a public reckoning over privacy and safety
items.blurb: Meta's Muse personal agents draw scrutiny over privacy and safety as always-on AI assistants reach billions of users.
